full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the present petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title Suit being No. 25 of 1995 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Fultala, Khulna for specific performance of contract against the opposite party Nos. 6-11 contending, inter alia, that late Abdur Rashid Molla, the predecessor in interest of the opposite party Nos. 6-10 being owner and possessor of 0.73 acres of land appertaining to CS plot Nos. 1939 and 1940 recorded in CS khatian Nos. 1996 and 1998 of Baniakhamar mouza of Khulna Police Station had entered into an agreement to sale 0.085 acres of land to the plaintiff at a consideration of Taka 50,000 and on receipt of an advance of Taka 20,000 executed a bainaparta on 8-2-1986 and thereafter took Taka 25,000 on 13-4-1986 and extended the time for execution and registration of the sale deed for a long period on the ground of pendency of a title suit. Subsequently Abdur Rashid Molla died leaving the present opposite party Nos. 6-10 as his heirs who ultimately refused to execute and register the sale deed on 20-3-1995.
